title: Luxuriantly Glazed British Lamb Stew
description: A rich and cozy British dish featuring lamb shanks in a molten glaze, wrapped in lotus leaves for a unique presentation. This stew is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shanks with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the red wine, beef broth, honey, and Dijon mustard to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb shanks for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling off the bone.
Wrap each lamb shank in a lotus leaf and serve hot.
